caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is an old-fashioned flat iron positioned centrally on a plain background. The iron features a thick, rounded handle with a wrapped texture, supported by two slightly curved arms that attach to a broad, roughly textured, trapezoidal base. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, showing careful shading and detail to illustrate the iron’s texture and form, including the pitted and uneven surface of the base and the spiraled grip of the handle. The background is featureless and a pale color, providing full contrast to the dark tones of the iron. There is a small, cursive signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Flatiron
